title: Inventions
subtitle: Technological innovations, artificial intelligence & modern gadgets

lessons.title: Getting started – Inventions for education
objectives: Gain an overview of the topic 'Inventions' and key vocabulary related to digital devices and educational applications;
Understand and use words and collocations describing modern inventions (smartphones, laptops, apps, convenient);
Identify the present perfect tense, gerunds, and to-infinitives in context.
Core Competences:
Develop communication skills, critical thinking, pair/teamwork collaboration, and adaptability;
Actively join in class activities.
Personal Qualities:
Foster curiosity, appreciation for technological innovations, and responsible habits when using educational apps.
Digital & AI Competences:
1: Explain the role of Artificial Intelligence and digital devices in modern inventions and daily life.
2: Identify and list digital applications and devices according to their functional educational features.
MR2: Use AI tools and search engines to gather and organize information about technological innovations.

lessons.title: Language – Stress in 3-syllable nouns & Present perfect tense vs. Gerunds
lessons.short_title: Stress in 3-syllable nouns & Present perfect tense vs. Gerunds
objectives: Pronounce common three-syllable nouns with correct stress patterns (stress on 1st syllable vs. 2nd syllable);
Understand and use lexical items related to computer components and scientific equipment (hardware, software, devices, laboratory, experiment);
Use the present perfect tense, gerunds, and to-infinitives correctly in sentences.
Core Competences:
Develop word stress discrimination, morphological unscrambling, and grammatical accuracy;
Work collaboratively in pairs and groups.
Personal Qualities:
Cultivate an inquiring scientific mind and responsible usage of digital hardware and software.
Digital & AI Competences:
2: Distinguish and classify technical computer components (Hardware, Software, Devices) according to system functions.
MR2: Practice using educational digital tools and AI applications to drill present perfect and infinitive verb patterns.

lessons.title: Reading – Artificial Intelligence in daily life
objectives: Read for main ideas and specific information in an article about Artificial Intelligence (AI) and humanoid robots (Sophia);
Understand and use vocabulary related to AI capabilities, machine decision-making, and emotion recognition;
Discuss practical applications of AI in education and schools.
Core Competences:
Develop skimming, scanning, detail deduction, and collaborative brainstorming skills;
Work in pairs and groups.
Personal Qualities:
Appreciate AI as an inspiring technological achievement while maintaining human control and ethics.
Digital & AI Competences:
1: Explain the role of Artificial Intelligence in modern inventions, robotics, and daily life.
2: Identify how AI operates in specific real-world applications (speech recognition, self-driving vehicles, medical diagnosis).
2: Understand human oversight and the principle that AI supports rather than replaces human decision-making.

lessons.title: Writing – Describing the benefits of an invention

Personal Qualities:

2: Maintain genuine authorship, declare AI brainstorming tools transparently, and submit the Student AI Declaration Form.
